<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1473
Claimant:
Billy Jones
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
18 May 2023
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection. The isnured reports the claimant's vehicle was struck
on the driver's side while proceeding through a green signal. A shoulder injury is reported and the claimant is
represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
28 Jun 2023
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. No issues with the
policy status were found.
15 Jul 2023
Obtained the police report, which lists the claimant as an occupant of the vehicle at the scene. The report's
description of the collision lines up with the damage recorded in the initial photos.
1 Aug 2023
Spoke with the other driver, who gave the same account of the impact as the insured. Statements from two
independent witnesses were also requested and are being collected.
13 Sep 2023
Reviewed the scene photos and the vehicle damage estimate. The damage is mostly in line with a side impact of the
type described, with the expected crush pattern along the driver's side.
17 Sep 2023
Received the vehicle's prior repair history and found no earlier damage to the same areas. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the policy start date.
2 Oct 2023
Counsel's office provided the medical records. The reported shoulder injury fits well with the kind and force of this
crash, and no earlier injury to the same body area appears in the records received.
5 Nov 2023
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of how the collision happened
matches the one given at first notice and in the earlier conversation with the adjuster.
9 Nov 2023
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of shoulder injury. Requested updated treatment
notes and a referral history to understand the timeline of care.
14 Nov 2023
Reviewed the claimant's account against the police report, witness statements, and photos. Everything collected so
far confirms the accident happened as described and that the claiamnt was in the vehicle at the time.
24 Nov 2023
File remains open pending receipt of the updated treatment notes and counsel's demand package. Next step is to
schedule a review of the medical records with the claims supervisor once those documents arrive.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
